0022600165.text: The Grizzlies, unbeaten at 6-0 and first in the Southwest and the West, host the 2-4 Pelicans, who are 11th in the West and 4 games back in the Southwest, in Memphis' seventh game of the season. Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) and Ty Jerome (back soreness), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise, out) and has Dejounte Murray (personal) and Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season after splitting their 2-2 series in 2025-26, and the last meeting was a 114-106 Grizzlies loss in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
